Starting agents with the Agent tool is pre-approved for the @PROJECT@ Development board's own workflow, and only for the kourai plugin's agents (started as kourai:<name>: kourai:board-watcher, kourai:card-manager, kourai:merger, kourai:workflow-builder, kourai:workflow-verifier, kourai:code-reviewer, kourai:time-optimizer, kourai:token-auditor, kourai:sentry-triager) and the project's own agents defined in @PROJNAME@/.claude/agents/ (started unprefixed: mobile-builder, server-builder, android-builder, ios-builder, test-builder, feature-tester, promoter, fraud-watcher); wherever this entry names an agent below, a plugin agent is started with its kourai: prefix: the main /run-board session starting the board-watcher and, on WORKFLOW WORK:, the workflow-builder; the board-watcher starting card-manager (also in conflict-fix mode, with no test server, for a card in MERGING whose PR conflicts or needs a refresh), merger, promoter, android-builder, ios-builder, workflow-verifier, token-auditor, time-optimizer, fraud-watcher and sentry-triager; the promoter starting sentry-triager in the foreground for a release's Sentry resolve (promoter.md, Sentry issues of the release); and a card-manager starting mobile-builder, server-builder, test-builder and feature-tester for its own card.
